parameters.content:
## PF Reward
Input: `{ invitee_uri }`. Called by PF Session Follow-up after the session ends, and later by the Darwin tool (manual path).

1. Choice: Send $50 / Other amount / No reward (links, back to Slack after the click).
2. Other: form link, whole dollars 1 to 100, one retry.
3. Confirm / Cancel.
4. Re-read the row (no second order), stub balance check (step 6b replaces it), Tremendous stub with `external_id` = invitee id.

No answer leaves the row as it is, so the manual path can pick it up.

parameters.query:
-- Column aliases keep the names the code nodes used with the mock table.
SELECT id, invitee_uri, booking_status, followup_status, rebook_status,
       organizer_email AS host_email, organizer_name AS host_name,
       title AS event_name, external_id AS event_uri,
       -- ISO text, the same format the code read from the mock table (DateTime.fromISO).
       to_char(starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS starts_at,
       to_char(ends_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS ends_at,
       participant_name, participant_first_name, participant_email,
       booking_link, reward_amount, reward_order_id, is_mock
FROM calendar_research_sessions
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'reward_declined',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'reward_declined',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'reward_declined',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

-- Read again right before the order: a second order is blocked when reward_order_id is set.
SELECT id, reward_order_id, followup_status
FROM calendar_research_sessions
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'rewarded',
    reward_amount = $2::numeric,
    reward_order_id = $3,
    rewarded_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET followup_status = 'reward_blocked',
    reward_amount = $2::numeric,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
RETURNING id;

nodeGroups.name: Check session
nodeGroups.description: Loads config and the row from Supabase, stops if already rewarded or the host fails the guard, builds all texts and messages.

nodeGroups.name: Ask reward
nodeGroups.description: DMs Send $50 / Other amount / No reward (links or buttons), waits, edits the message with the choice.

nodeGroups.name: Other amount (form)
nodeGroups.description: Links mode or modal fallback: DMs a form link for whole dollars 1 to 100 and waits for the form.

nodeGroups.name: Other amount (modal)
nodeGroups.description: Buttons mode: PF Button Router opened a Slack modal; waits for its amount and checks it again (1 to 100).

nodeGroups.name: Amount retry
nodeGroups.description: One retry with the form when the amount is not valid or did not arrive.

nodeGroups.name: Confirm
nodeGroups.description: Asks Send $X to name (email)? with Confirm / Cancel (links or buttons), edits the message.

nodeGroups.name: Place order
nodeGroups.description: Builds the order body, sends it to Tremendous (live, production only) or the stub, reads the result: ok, no funds or error.

nodeGroups.name: Order sent
nodeGroups.description: Marks the row rewarded with the order id and shows it in the host DM.

nodeGroups.name: Tell admin about order
nodeGroups.description: No funds or error: DMs the admin with the Tremendous answer.

nodeGroups.name: Balance too low
nodeGroups.description: No order: row reward_blocked, DM explains, the admin gets a DM.
